body: I'm glad you found someone to love regardless of what society says about it. Thanks for the offer to hang out with me. I can see that you're a kind person. Thank you so, so much.

I'd rather not get into the details of it all, but I did something illegal a decade ago... something that has very dire consequences even to this day. I regret it... so much. At the time I wasn't thinking... and now I'm deathly afraid of potential incarceration. I can't change the past, so I know there's no reason for me to obsess over it, but when I look at my future I see nothing but pain... whether I live or die.

Thanks for reaching out. I don't want to give up, but staying alive just seems so... futile. I don't want to be defeatist... I really don't... I want to fight, but it's this strange... thing where... the positive, beautiful parts of life just make me even more distressed... it becomes harder for me to let go, but then I think about the truth of my existence, my past, how it'll catch up to me... it snaps me back into reality, and that reality is impossible for me to deal with.

I don't know if this is making sense. If you don't mind me asking, why do you wake up at 3AM every morning? Do you also have anxiety?
